summary: Aura Biosciences filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering includes an unspecified number of shares and warrants, with a portion of net proceeds expected to repurchase shares from Matrix Capital Management Master Fund. The last sale price was $7.01 per share on May 1, 2026. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; it does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, liquidation, or similar event. No special-situations category applies.
